think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and meaning from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether the knob has one or more sentinel numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the behavior into a qualitatively different mode (e.g., disable/force a feature) rather than just adjusting magnitude. 3) If such sentinel values exist and are documented to change the knob’s function (not just set a threshold), classify it as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s). Otherwise, classify it as not special.
